name: Grey Matter
abilities: Understands and repairs alien tech at a glance (incl. the Omnitrix)
Wall scaling via microscopic skin pads
weaknesses: Six-inch size makes him useless in a physical fight
Animals may treat him as prey or a chew toy
Massive disadvantage against an Omnivoracious (Nemetrix predator)
summary: A six-inch Galvan brain-box: physically helpless but able to out-think any problem and rebuild alien machinery from spare parts.
traits: Omnitrix worn on his back in OS and OV
notableFeats: Beat Kraab and SixSix by outsmarting them (Hunted)
Sent Phil into the Null Void and stopped a Null Guardian (Truth)
Built a Sun Gun to fight Zs'Skayr and Dr. Viktor (Be Afraid of the Dark)
Disabled the alien prisoners' shock implants aboard the Megacruiser (Grudge Match)
Defeated Tyrannopede (Of Predators and Prey: Part 2)

appearances.designNotes: White jumpsuit with a thin vertical black stripe, yellowish-green eyes, larger stripe on the forehead, original Omnitrix on his back.

appearances.firstEpisode: So Long, and Thanks for All the Smoothies
notableEpisodes: So Long, and Thanks for All the Smoothies
It's a Mad, Mad, Mad Ben World: Part 2
appearances.designNotes: Green jumpsuit with black belt and collar, black fingerless gloves with green squares, no head stripe, longer neck, Omnitrix on his back. 11-year-old version (design only) is the OS look with black collar and green eyes.

scoring.rationale: Genius intellect (understands and repairs the Omnitrix, builds a Sun Gun from junk) is his whole game; at six inches tall he cannot fight, lift or take a hit and needs to be hidden from pets.

notes: Not used in Alien Force (locked) or Ultimate Alien (only in the UA intro; re-unlocked in Ben 10,000 Returns).
Also used by Ken (Ken 10), Gwen (Gwen 10, non-canon) and No Watch Ben (And Then There Was Ben) - not counted.
11-year-old OV design is described on the wiki but no 11-year-old on-screen use is listed in Appearances.
